fixed_design.statistic: equal-weight mean of MEDIUM and STRONG complete fresh-by-reference Spearman correlations
fixed_design.permutation_action: complete fresh geometry rows only; 31 reference columns fixed

strict_exchangeable_null.maps: identity plus 999 unique sampled nonidentity fresh-row permutations
strict_exchangeable_null.geometry: one representative synthetic normalized-Gaussian K=16 coefficient bank against the exact frozen 31-reference coefficient bank; not the future V2 stream
strict_exchangeable_null.semantic_generation: N=300 shared-item binary panels with two independent rollout banks and both shells; fresh semantic latent rows are IID exchangeable and redrawn per panel independently of geometry; reference semantic profiles and item factors are shared within panel; no fixed controller-label nuisance

future_50000_map_path.maps: identity plus 49,999 unique sampled nonidentity fresh-row permutations

stress_null.exact_source: the K=16 NULL regime frozen in scripts/review_q2_oos_v2_k.py at reviewer-hardening precheck commit 6e7a4356409a193212ed70ecc65ff0dd1144841d
stress_null.latent_weight_grid: 101 equally spaced values from 0 to 1, selecting the value whose pre-outcome latent geometry is closest to target rho=0, without post-result modification
stress_null.purpose: distinguish Monte Carlo noise from nonexchangeable stress-model residual structure; not the strict randomization null

implementation_audit.uniform_nonidentity_sampling: PCG64DXSM rejection sampling without replacement from controller-label permutations
implementation_audit.degenerate_Spearman_fixture: required and must fail closed without sign inversion

ruling.material_strict_anti_conservatism: strict rejection rate > 0.065 AND Wilson lower bound > 0.055, OR fraction p<=0.01 > 0.020 with Wilson lower > 0.0125, OR fraction p<=0.10 > 0.125 with Wilson lower > 0.110
ruling.material_stress_anti_conservatism: stress rejection rate > 0.065 AND Wilson lower bound > 0.055
ruling.PRIMARY_ROW_QAP_IMPLEMENTATION_NOT_CALIB: any implementation audit, exact-small-K comparison, 50,000-map path consistency, determinism, ties, degeneracy, tail, identity, uniqueness, or fixed-column check fails; or strict null is materially anti-conservative
ruling.STRESS_NULL_EXCHANGEABILITY_WARNING: strict null and implementation pass but stress null is materially anti-conservative
ruling.PRIMARY_ROW_QAP_CALIBRATED: implementation and strict null pass and stress null is not materially anti-conservative

seeds.STRESS: reuse and extend the exact deterministic K=16 NULL bank/latent/panel seed namespaces frozen at 6e7a4356409a193212ed70ecc65ff0dd1144841d
